set.body: Slice 4 of epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ. NOTE THE OWNER RELAXED THE NO-JS CONSTRAINT: the binding requirement is LOCAL OPENABILITY -- 'as long as it can be easily opened locally... in a browser or other document' -- not script-freedom. No external resources and offline behaviour stay, because those serve local openability. Extends CodexHtml's existing guarantees: concatenated span text IS canonical text (V-T2); a name resolves identically in text and graphic layers (V-I2); no colour carries meaning. Per O4, HTML is a REPORT: it owes deterministic regeneration, twin equality, receipts and honest coverage, but NOT parse(render(model)) == model.
set.title: S4 output bundle: locally-openable HTML/CSS renderer contract extending CodexHtml
